Answer "supported" only if the sentences state that Ground Delay Program produces or sends this item AND that Regional Flow Manager receives or uses the same item (it may be named more briefly in one sentence). response: {"verdict":"unsupported","reason":"S842 says the Regional Flow Manager uses the delay absorption indicator to check that the Ground Delay Program did not create excessive departure congestion, so congestion is something to be avoided and verified, not an item the program provides to the manager."}
